verifiedSurfaceSummary: Current corporate jobs controls delegate to the exact BootLabs LinkedIn company jobs URL, which redirects to its public employer profile. Runtime verifies the native company facet and corporate website, preserves all rendered announcement text and original announcement dates, and reconciles closing models. Announcement/activity IDs are not job or formal requisition IDs; headquarters and city-only post copy are not job countries. A keyword no-match page does not prove zero native vacancies.
